description: This file defines the EntityTypeBundleInfo class, which provides discovery and retrieval of entity type bundle information within Drupal. It manages caching, loading, and clearing of bundle data, and interacts with various Drupal core services.

classes.name: EntityTypeBundleInfo
classes.description: Provides discovery and retrieval of entity type bundles, managing cache and interaction with Drupal core services.

methods.name: getBundleInfo
methods.description: Returns bundle information for a specific entity type ID, with deprecation warning for non-string input.

methods.name: getBundleLabels
methods.description: Returns labels for all bundles of a specific entity type.

methods.name: getAllBundleInfo
methods.description: Retrieves all bundle information, either from cache or by loading from entity storage and invoking hooks.

methods.name: clearCachedBundles
methods.description: Clears the cached bundle information and related caches.
